description_es: Técnica de respiración profunda para calmar el sistema nervioso y reducir la ansiedad en minutos.
description_en: A deep breathing technique to calm the nervous system and reduce anxiety within minutes.

steps.instruction_es: Siéntate con la espalda recta y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
steps.instruction_en: Sit with your back straight and feet flat on the floor.

steps.instruction_es: Inhala por la nariz contando hasta 4.
steps.instruction_en: Inhale through your nose for a count of 4.

steps.instruction_es: Mantén el aire contando hasta 7.
steps.instruction_en: Hold your breath for a count of 7.

steps.instruction_es: Exhala lentamente por la boca contando hasta 8.
steps.instruction_en: Exhale slowly through your mouth for a count of 8.

description_es: Recorre tu cuerpo con atención plena para liberar tensiones acumuladas y reconectar con el presente.
description_en: Scan your body mindfully to release built-up tension and reconnect with the present.

steps.instruction_es: Túmbate en una posición cómoda.
steps.instruction_en: Lie down in a comfortable position.

steps.instruction_es: Cierra los ojos y enfócate en tus pies.
steps.instruction_en: Close your eyes and focus on your feet.

steps.instruction_es: Sube gradualmente la atención hasta la cabeza.
steps.instruction_en: Gradually move your attention up to your head.

steps.instruction_es: Observa cada zona sin juzgar y suelta la tensión.
steps.instruction_en: Notice each area without judgment and release tension.

description_es: Tensa y relaja grupos musculares de forma secuencial para disminuir el estrés físico y mental.
description_en: Tense and relax muscle groups sequentially to reduce physical and mental stress.

steps.instruction_es: Comienza con los músculos de los pies durante 5 segundos.
steps.instruction_en: Start with your foot muscles for 5 seconds.

steps.instruction_es: Suelta la tensión y nota la diferencia.
steps.instruction_en: Release the tension and notice the difference.

steps.instruction_es: Repite con piernas, abdomen, manos y rostro.
steps.instruction_en: Repeat with legs, abdomen, hands and face.

steps.instruction_es: Termina respirando profundo tres veces.
steps.instruction_en: Finish with three deep breaths.

description_es: Imagina un lugar seguro y sereno para cultivar calma interior y claridad emocional.
description_en: Picture a safe, peaceful place to cultivate inner calm and emotional clarity.

steps.instruction_es: Cierra los ojos y respira de forma natural.
steps.instruction_en: Close your eyes and breathe naturally.

steps.instruction_es: Visualiza un entorno que te transmita paz.
steps.instruction_en: Visualize an environment that brings you peace.

steps.instruction_es: Explora los detalles con todos tus sentidos.
steps.instruction_en: Explore the details with all your senses.

steps.instruction_es: Permanece ahí unos minutos antes de regresar.
steps.instruction_en: Stay there for a few minutes before returning.

description_es: Activa el diafragma para oxigenar el cuerpo y activar la respuesta de relajación.
description_en: Engage your diaphragm to oxygenate the body and trigger the relaxation response.

steps.instruction_es: Coloca una mano en el pecho y otra en el abdomen.
steps.instruction_en: Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly.

steps.instruction_es: Inhala haciendo que suba el abdomen, no el pecho.
steps.instruction_en: Inhale so your belly rises, not your chest.

steps.instruction_es: Exhala lentamente por la boca.
steps.instruction_en: Exhale slowly through your mouth.

steps.instruction_es: Repite durante 5 minutos.
steps.instruction_en: Repeat for 5 minutes.

description_es: Reconoce tres aspectos positivos de tu día para equilibrar la mente y el ánimo.
description_en: Acknowledge three positive aspects of your day to balance mind and mood.

steps.instruction_es: Respira profundo y centra tu atención.
steps.instruction_en: Breathe deeply and center your attention.

steps.instruction_es: Piensa en algo que agradezcas hoy.
steps.instruction_en: Think of something you are grateful for today.

steps.instruction_es: Repite con dos elementos más.
steps.instruction_en: Repeat with two more items.

steps.instruction_es: Sonríe suavemente y abre los ojos.
steps.instruction_en: Smile gently and open your eyes.

description_es: Movimientos suaves para soltar rigidez en la zona superior del cuerpo tras largas jornadas.
description_en: Gentle movements to release upper-body stiffness after long days.

steps.instruction_es: Inclina la cabeza hacia un lado sin forzar.
steps.instruction_en: Tilt your head to one side without forcing.

steps.instruction_es: Repite hacia el otro lado.
steps.instruction_en: Repeat on the other side.

steps.instruction_es: Eleva los hombros y suéltalos de golpe.
steps.instruction_en: Raise your shoulders and drop them suddenly.

steps.instruction_es: Realiza círculos lentos con el cuello.
steps.instruction_en: Make slow circles with your neck.

description_es: Ritmo equilibrado de inhalar, sostener, exhalar y pausar para recuperar el foco.
description_en: A balanced rhythm of inhale, hold, exhale and pause to regain focus.

steps.instruction_es: Inhala contando hasta 4.
steps.instruction_en: Inhale for a count of 4.

steps.instruction_es: Mantén el aire 4 segundos.
steps.instruction_en: Hold for 4 seconds.

steps.instruction_es: Exhala durante 4 segundos.
steps.instruction_en: Exhale for 4 seconds.

steps.instruction_es: Pausa 4 segundos y repite el ciclo.
steps.instruction_en: Pause 4 seconds and repeat the cycle.

description_es: Transporta tu mente a la orilla del mar para descansar y soltar preocupaciones.
description_en: Transport your mind to the seashore to rest and let go of worries.

steps.instruction_es: Cierra los ojos e imagina el sonido de las olas.
steps.instruction_en: Close your eyes and imagine the sound of waves.

steps.instruction_es: Siente la brisa suave en tu piel.
steps.instruction_en: Feel the gentle breeze on your skin.

steps.instruction_es: Visualiza la arena cálida bajo tus pies.
steps.instruction_en: Picture warm sand beneath your feet.

steps.instruction_es: Respira al ritmo del mar.
steps.instruction_en: Breathe in rhythm with the sea.

description_es: Observa cada inhalación y exhalación como ancla al momento presente.
description_en: Observe each inhale and exhale as an anchor to the present moment.

steps.instruction_es: Siéntate en silencio con la espalda erguida.
steps.instruction_en: Sit quietly with an upright back.

steps.instruction_es: Lleva la atención a la entrada y salida del aire.
steps.instruction_en: Bring attention to the air flowing in and out.

steps.instruction_es: Si la mente divaga, vuelve suavemente a la respiración.
steps.instruction_en: If your mind wanders, gently return to the breath.

steps.instruction_es: Continúa durante 10 minutos.
steps.instruction_en: Continue for 10 minutes.

description_es: Suelta la tensión mandibular frecuente en el estrés y el trabajo concentrado.
description_en: Release jaw tension common with stress and focused work.

steps.instruction_es: Separa ligeramente los dientes sin abrir la boca.
steps.instruction_en: Part your teeth slightly without opening your mouth.

steps.instruction_es: Masajea suavemente los músculos de la mandíbula.
steps.instruction_en: Gently massage your jaw muscles.

steps.instruction_es: Realiza movimientos circulares con la lengua.
steps.instruction_en: Make circular movements with your tongue.

steps.instruction_es: Respira profundo y relaja el rostro.
steps.instruction_en: Breathe deeply and relax your face.

description_es: Combina movimiento lento y respiración para despertar el cuerpo con calma.
description_en: Combine slow movement and breathing to awaken the body calmly.

steps.instruction_es: Eleva los brazos al inhalar.
steps.instruction_en: Raise your arms as you inhale.

steps.instruction_es: Baja lentamente al exhalar.
steps.instruction_en: Lower slowly as you exhale.

steps.instruction_es: Inclínate suavemente hacia los lados.
steps.instruction_en: Gently lean to each side.

steps.instruction_es: Termina en postura neutral y respira.
steps.instruction_en: End in a neutral posture and breathe.

description_es: Equilibra el sistema nervioso alternando la respiración por cada fosa nasal.
description_en: Balance the nervous system by alternating breath through each nostril.

steps.instruction_es: Cierra la fosa nasal derecha con el pulgar.
steps.instruction_en: Close your right nostril with your thumb.

steps.instruction_es: Inhala por la fosa izquierda.
steps.instruction_en: Inhale through the left nostril.

steps.instruction_es: Cierra la izquierda e inhala por la derecha.
steps.instruction_en: Close the left and inhale through the right.

steps.instruction_es: Continúa alternando durante varios ciclos.
steps.instruction_en: Keep alternating for several cycles.

description_es: Usa tus sentidos para salir del piloto automático y volver al aquí y ahora.
description_en: Use your senses to step out of autopilot and return to the here and now.

steps.instruction_es: Nombra 5 cosas que puedes ver.
steps.instruction_en: Name 5 things you can see.

steps.instruction_es: Nombra 4 cosas que puedes tocar.
steps.instruction_en: Name 4 things you can touch.

steps.instruction_es: Nombra 3 sonidos que escuchas.
steps.instruction_en: Name 3 sounds you hear.

steps.instruction_es: Respira profundo y confirma que estás presente.
steps.instruction_en: Breathe deeply and confirm you are present.

description_es: Rutina breve para preparar cuerpo y mente antes de descansar.
description_en: A short routine to prepare body and mind before rest.

steps.instruction_es: Apaga pantallas y atenúa las luces.
steps.instruction_en: Turn off screens and dim the lights.

steps.instruction_es: Respira lento por la nariz.
steps.instruction_en: Breathe slowly through your nose.

steps.instruction_es: Relaja hombros, mandíbula y manos.
steps.instruction_en: Relax shoulders, jaw and hands.

steps.instruction_es: Permanece en quietud hasta sentir sueño.
steps.instruction_en: Stay still until you feel sleepy.

description_es: Ideal tras escribir o usar el teclado; devuelve ligereza a tus manos.
description_en: Ideal after typing; restores lightness to your hands.

steps.instruction_es: Abre y cierra los puños varias veces.
steps.instruction_en: Open and close your fists several times.

steps.instruction_es: Estira cada dedo individualmente.
steps.instruction_en: Stretch each finger individually.

steps.instruction_es: Masajea la palma con el pulgar.
steps.instruction_en: Massage your palm with your thumb.

steps.instruction_es: Sacude las manos y respira.
steps.instruction_en: Shake your hands and breathe.

description_es: Imagina una luz cálida que recorre tu cuerpo sanando y calmando.
description_en: Imagine warm light traveling through your body, healing and calming.

steps.instruction_es: Visualiza una luz suave sobre tu cabeza.
steps.instruction_en: Visualize a soft light above your head.

steps.instruction_es: Deja que descienda lentamente por el cuerpo.
steps.instruction_en: Let it slowly descend through your body.

steps.instruction_es: En cada zona, suelta tensión al exhalar.
steps.instruction_en: In each area, release tension as you exhale.

steps.instruction_es: Termina con la luz envolviendo todo tu cuerpo.
steps.instruction_en: End with the light surrounding your whole body.

description_es: Ritmo de 5 segundos por fase para sincronizar corazón y respiración.
description_en: A 5-second per phase rhythm to sync heart and breath.

steps.instruction_es: Inhala durante 5 segundos.
steps.instruction_en: Inhale for 5 seconds.

steps.instruction_es: Exhala durante 5 segundos.
steps.instruction_en: Exhale for 5 seconds.

steps.instruction_es: Mantén un ritmo constante y suave.
steps.instruction_en: Keep a steady, gentle rhythm.

steps.instruction_es: Continúa durante 10 minutos.
steps.instruction_en: Continue for 10 minutes.

description_es: Micro-rutina para interrumpir el estrés durante el día laboral o académico.
description_en: A micro-routine to interrupt stress during work or study.

steps.instruction_es: Detén lo que haces y siéntate erguido.
steps.instruction_en: Stop what you are doing and sit upright.

steps.instruction_es: Toma tres respiraciones profundas.
steps.instruction_en: Take three deep breaths.

steps.instruction_es: Observa cómo te sientes sin juzgar.
steps.instruction_en: Notice how you feel without judging.

steps.instruction_es: Retoma tu actividad con intención.
steps.instruction_en: Return to your activity with intention.

description_es: Separa conscientemente el día activo del momento de descanso.
description_en: Consciously separate your active day from your rest time.

steps.instruction_es: Escribe una frase sobre cómo fue tu día.
steps.instruction_en: Write one sentence about how your day went.

steps.instruction_es: Respira profundo y suelta los hombros.
steps.instruction_en: Breathe deeply and drop your shoulders.

steps.instruction_es: Agradece algo positivo del día.
steps.instruction_en: Appreciate one positive thing from the day.

steps.instruction_es: Realiza un escaneo corporal breve.
steps.instruction_en: Do a brief body scan.
